name: pal-mcp-server
description: Consult Gemini, OpenAI, Grok, OpenRouter and local models from Claude.
long_description: PAL (Provider Abstraction Layer) lets Claude hand work to other models — second opinions, multi-model consensus, code review, debugging, planning, and CLI-to-CLI bridging (clink) — while keeping one conversation context. Configure at least one provider key; the rest can stay empty. Claude Desktop installs the Python dependencies with uv on first launch.

gemini_api_key.title: Gemini API key
gemini_api_key.description: From https://aistudio.google.com/apikey. Leave empty to skip this provider.

openai_api_key.title: OpenAI API key
openai_api_key.description: From https://platform.openai.com/api-keys. Leave empty to skip this provider.

openrouter_api_key.title: OpenRouter API key
openrouter_api_key.description: From https://openrouter.ai/keys. One key for many vendors' models.

xai_api_key.title: X.AI API key
xai_api_key.description: From https://console.x.ai/. Leave empty to skip this provider.

azure_openai_api_key.title: Azure OpenAI API key
azure_openai_api_key.description: Needs the Azure OpenAI endpoint below as well.

dial_api_key.title: DIAL API key
dial_api_key.description: From https://dialx.ai/. Leave empty to skip this provider.

opencode_api_key.title: OpenCode Go API key
opencode_api_key.description: From https://opencode.ai/docs/go/. Leave empty to skip this provider.

custom_api_url.title: Custom / Ollama endpoint
custom_api_url.description: OpenAI-compatible URL for local models, e.g. http://localhost:11434/v1 for Ollama (the /v1 suffix is required).

default_model.title: Default model
default_model.description: Model name, or 'auto' to let Claude pick per task.

disabled_tools.title: Disabled tools
disabled_tools.description: Comma-separated tool names to hide. Clear it to enable every tool.
